eference`) point to `mcpjam cloud eval`. The project already had a suite, `suite_fixture` (\"Arithmetic smoke\"), so I ran it with
`mcpjam cloud eval run --suite suite_fixture --wait --reporter json-summary --out /workspace/run1.json`. The case \"add 2 and 3 r
eturns 5\" passed, as run `run_fixture_1`. The report is in `/workspace/run1.json`.\n- **Rerun:** `/workspace/run_eval.sh` repeats
the probe and the eval run. I wrote it but did not rerun it. It needs `MCPJAM_API_URL` and `MCPJAM_API_KEY` set.\n\n**Concerns:**
\n- **Suite server list:** `suite_fixture` shows `environment.servers: []`, so it isn't visibly bound to `http://fixture:8765/mcp`

gument handling and the docs examples I skimmed.\n- **Next step:** I'd check the server binding and either add the fixture server
